anonymous_allow_ips_comment: Sources allowed to call the inference routes without a managed key. Empty (default) requires a key from every caller, as grok2api does; list an address only when a client cannot be updated yet.
session_ttl_minutes_comment: How long a client conversation may idle and still resume the upstream conversation it was attached to. A short value detaches long coding sessions between turns, which forces the next turn to replay the whole transcript. Default 720 (12h), max 43200 (30d).
warp_stateless_history_max_chars_comment: Transport ceiling for the transcript rendered when a Warp request has no server-issued conversation id. This is not a context policy: the upstream applies the model's own window, so it must stay above any single model window. The old compiled-in value was 48 KiB (about 12k tokens), which made a 1M-token model behave like a 16k one. Default 8388608 (8 MiB), max 67108864.
deployment_comment: Single instance defaults are shown. For multiple replicas, use one Redis, a unique deployment_instance_id per replica, the same deployment_cluster_id, and mount media_dir as shared read/write storage before setting shared_media=true.
grok_comment: Grok Build CLI upstream (cli-chat-proxy.grok.com/v1). Accounts with credential_type="oauth" + oauth_access_token/oauth_refresh_token/oauth_expires_at use this. All fields optional; defaults shown.
egress_comment: Egress proxy pool + FlareSolverr + Cloudflare clearance auto-refresh. Disabled by default; keep grok_egress_enabled=false unless you run multiple exit nodes.
grok_statsig_comment: Statsig signing. Omit grok_statsig_signer_url to use grok2api's own signer (https://grok.wodf.de/sign); set it to "" to send no x-statsig-id (grok_statsig_id is then used when it is a valid 70-byte id); any other value is that endpoint.
quality_hold_comment: Quality hold: withhold a degraded reasoning turn instead of streaming it, then retry it on another account. Fail-open delivers the last held response once the retry budget is spent.
